The composition is overlaid with a continuous ambient light source that pulses gently through a spectrum of colors — transitioning from vibrant blues to warm golds — creating a rhythmic radiance across the entire diagram. The effect is achieved through a combination of color cycling and dynamic transparency layers that simulate glowing particles emanating from each element tile, resulting in an ethereal, pulsating visual experience that captures both scientific organization and organic luminosity.
